notes.title: Four to five sensors with LEDs
notes.body: Use the selected multiplexer architecture. Bring channels up individually, then prove the complete 4–5 sensor group with valid readings, stable resets and the intended LED behavior.

notes.title: Measure and mock up the layout
notes.body: Choose presence, ordered direction or step coverage. Survey the route and test sensor views, diffusers, removable mounts and an accessible controller location.

notes.title: Power and cable runs need evidence
notes.body: Use the actual strip load and measured lengths to design wire, protection and injection. Validate I²C timing at intended cable lengths; a mux does not guarantee long-distance communication.

notes.title: Keep current firmware and recovery distinct
notes.body: The 90-pixel smooth rainbow ripple is the current single-sensor bench. The 60-pixel combined recovery bundle, original firmware and standalone diagnostics remain separate.
